observed_tie_exception.interpretation: A true equal-distance tie within all calipers. Observed selection follows bounded-neighbor tie semantics; the stronger global-coordinate rule was not satisfied. No interval changed.

scope: Append-only clarification of recorded construction semantics; no selected interval, label, control, caliper, threshold, or training rule was changed.

nearest_neighbor_ties.distance: minimum unused Chebyshev distance subject to all3calipers and exact strata
nearest_neighbor_ties.returned_batch: cKDTree.query k=min(64,n), then ×4 up to1024 or n; if queried candidates exhausted, radius-one query_ball_point fallback; see executed code for exhaustion branches
nearest_neighbor_ties.tie_resolution: lexsort(distance, coordinate-ID-sorted candidate index) within returned candidate batch; fallback radius query considers all returned radius candidates
nearest_neighbor_ties.initial_wording_exception: Initial brief specification said coordinate-ID order resolves ties without stating bounded candidate scope. That does NOT guarantee globally lowest coordinate ID if a distance tie extends beyond k.
nearest_neighbor_ties.synthetic_counterexample: 1000 points all Chebyshev distance1; k64 can omit global index0. This establishes a specification-precision issue, not an error in actual calipers or frozen counts.
nearest_neighbor_ties.reproducibility: Actual matched interval IDs and all software/code/data hashes are frozen. Do not rerun using an assumed globally lexicographic tie implementation.

A_ATAC_signal_missingness.definition: signal percentile exists only for exact donor ATAC summit anchors; most historical A controls lack such a source-matched intensity value
A_ATAC_signal_missingness.warning: A control signal SMD uses available values only. Table control_n is the full control count, not the observed-intensity denominator. Empty anchor-lobe metadata is not evidence of no ATAC overlap.
A_ATAC_signal_missingness.correct_accessibility_audit: Use atac_overlap_1kb / atac_overlap_2001 / atac_overlap_summit from feature table and independent source audit; separate availability/distribution table provides observed denominators.
A_ATAC_signal_missingness.B_C: All new controls are ATAC anchors with available source-normalized signal; same missingness problem does not apply.

artifact_validation_vs_readiness.artifact_validation: checks faithful source construction, exclusion rules, exact memberships, hashes, arithmetic and documented algorithm
artifact_validation_vs_readiness.training_readiness: FAIL until matching issues are resolved in a separately approved version; artifact validation cannot waive biological design gates

primary_dataset_preservation: A exact historical membership; B all V1 positives; C same-lobe subset; B/C exact same selected controls. No control reuse by genomic ID.
conditional_next_design: Review C-specific rematching (labels plus induced rematching) and B common-support/ratio tradeoff. Do not silently drop positives, loosen gates, or start new configurations.
test_data_policy: Only prescribed construction/availability/covariate QC was performed; no model scores or performance-driven test decisions.
